name: Frappe du Péléide
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D GAME ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, not concept variants. Reference image defines the EXACT character Passe-rive: lean adult masked underworld spear warrior, petrol hood, ivory angular mask with black diagonal markings, small bronze circular brooch, sage jade asymmetric short shoulder drape, slim black costume, long ivory sash at waist, bronze wrist/ankle bands, dark sandals. Preserve his design, slim proportions and painted graphic style, broad flat shadow shapes, no extra details. Right anatomical hand owns dark spear with long sage blade; left anatomical arm carries dark oval shield with bronze rim and diagonal sage stripe. Never exchange hands. Three-quarter camera facing screen RIGHT, fixed camera at same modest downward angle as reference.
Output ONE large square image arranged EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells, reading left to right then bottom row. Four distinct sequential full-body keyframes of ONE action. White pure #FFFFFF background, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no text, no grid lines, no glow/background mist. Each cell entirely separate, nothing crosses cell boundaries. SAME character scale in all four cells; standing height approximately 68% of cell height, soles on common ground baseline at 89% cell height. Torso center near horizontal center of each cell. Full spear, shield, head, feet always inside each cell with clear margins. Large drawn movement, anatomy connected, believable shoulder-elbow-wrist and hip-knee-ankle coordination. Stable costume and head volume. These drawings will be sequenced into a punchy hand-drawn animation; no four almost-identical standing poses. NO VFX on the body sheet, action must read by silhouette alone.
ACTION CHOREOGRAPHY:
Powerful ONE HANDED SPEAR THRUST toward screen right, free shield on other forearm. Cell1 anticipation: weight over rear LEFT-screen foot, knees bent, torso wound to screen left, spear hand drawn all the way beside rear hip, spear horizontal with tip already aimed right. Shield close to left shoulder; feet apart. Cell2 striking extension: front foot steps far right and is flat planted, front knee bends, back leg extends left, hips and chest drive toward right, entire right spear arm extends strongly right at shoulder height, spear perfectly straight horizontal, tip very far right but fully inside cell. Torso clearly leans into thrust, not just isolated arm. Cell3 recoil: planted wide stance unchanged, elbow bends and draws spear back under armpit, shield still protects ribs, cloth lags right. Cell4 recover upright guarded three-quarter stance, weight central, knees soft, spear angled up to screen right ready for next move. No extra limbs or second spear.
